### God’s Wisdom in the Gospel
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-wisdom-gospel
Passage: Romans 16:27
Points:
- Paul concludes Romans by praising the unmatched wisdom of the only true God revealed in the gospel.
- Rebellious humanity traded worship of the Creator for futile idols, earning divine judgment.
- God demonstrates His wisdom by offering Christ's righteousness to sinners as a gift through faith alone.
- Justification brings peace with God and gives believers the Holy Spirit to bear fruit in obedience.
- Recognizing God's sovereign grace in redemption leads to lifelong adoration and praise of His glory.
